subject: Onsite AV scoping: codec compatibility, lounge network & courier routing
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel@avpros.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite AV scoping: codec compatibility, lounge network & courier routing

Hi Miguel / Samantha —

We’re kicking off planning for the exec workshop at AcmeCorp HQ on June 14–15. Before the vendor walk-through next week I want to confirm a few engineering-level items so the on-site test goes smoothly: 

1) Codec compatibility: the meeting rooms need SIP/H.323 interoperability with our dedicated Redwood bridge (we also use WebRTC for breakout rooms). Can you confirm whether the Polycom/Spectrum kit on the 7th floor supports simultaneous SIP and WebRTC transcodes or whether we’ll need an external transcode appliance?

2) Lobby network: the attendee lounge will host three streaming stations (one keynote stream + two regional feeds). We need a 150 Mbps sustained egress SLA from the local switch, with VLAN segmentation and QoS for RTP. Can you advise if the building ISP supports an on-site temporary BGP announcement or whether we should plan for cellular bond fallback?

3) Camera positions & power: we prefer two PTZ cameras per main room (USB/SDI options) and redundant PoE lines with UPS-backed PDUs for at least 90 minutes of room operation. Please flag any battery constraints.

4) Logistics: vendor gear will arrive at 0700 on June 14. We’ll need freight elevator access and a secure storage room near loading dock B. Also confirm whether you’ll need an on-site parking pass for a crew vehicle.

Attached are a rough lobby floorplan and recent site photos. Please bring a codec matrix (formats + firmware versions) to the walk-through and share any pre-test checklist items.

Goal for the walk-through: confirm codec interoperability, map camera axes, validate network egress, and set a 2-hour test window on June 13 (preferred) or June 14 morning.

Thanks — Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Head of Events & Workshops | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
From: Miguel Torres <miguel@avpros.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite AV scoping: codec compatibility, lounge network & courier routing

Sean — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick answers and what we’ll bring to the walk-through: 

- Codec support: the main 7th-floor Polycom Trio systems are SIP-native and will register to your SIP domain. H.323 is supported via a bridge appliance in the comms rack but the on-board firmware is old (v3.2). We recommend bringing a portable transcode unit if you plan to mix H.323 endpoints and WebRTC clients. I’m attaching a preliminary codec_matrix_v1.xlsx with firmware versions and RTP/RTCP port ranges.

- Lobby network: building fiber currently nails ~500 Mbps down but the ISP will only allow a temporary VLAN — no BGP announcements. We can provision a dedicated VLAN and request QoS, but we should plan for cellular bonding as a fallback. We’ll bring an LTE aggregator (bonded) that can handle failover for the keynote stream.

- Cameras & power: PTZs will be SDI with NDI option via a converter box. We’ll provide two PoE+ switches and an APC UPS rack for 120 minutes at moderate load. If you want 90-minute UPS runtime on each PDU outlet, please confirm the battery cycle expectation.

- Logistics & crew: we’ll arrive 0700 on June 14 with a 4-person crew and two transit cases. We need loading dock B access and a pass for one van.

Attachments: codec_matrix_v1.xlsx; site_photos_5-28.zip

Proposed walk-through times: Jun 11 afternoon (remote pre-call), Jun 12 onsite (preferred), or Jun 13 test window per your note. If Jun 12 works for Redwood, we’ll reserve that.

—Miguel
Miguel Torres
Lead Systems Engineer | AVPros
miguel@avpros.com | +1 408-555-3344
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Miguel Torres <miguel@avpros.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite AV scoping: codec compatibility, lounge network & courier routing

Thanks Miguel — that matrix is helpful. A few additions from Ops / Travel: 

- Travel & crew: Redwood will cover one parking pass and expedited dock clearance for AVPros. Miguel — please confirm the transit case dimensions (length/width/height) so the dock team can pre-stage a pallet.

- Test window: Jun 13 14:00–16:00 PT works best for our US + EU engineering leads. We’ll run a layered test: SIP registration stress (+500 SIP calls/min simulated), WebRTC breakouts using our staging token, and a keynote stream at 6 Mbps to validate composite transcoding. Please include expected CPU/RAM usage for the transcode box so we can verify power draws.

- Camera positions: attached is a slightly updated lobby floorplan (redwood-ops-lobby-floorplan.pdf). Can you mark on the plan where you’d like the two PTZ mounts and the two ceiling mics? If NDI is used, we’ll need multicast enabled on the VLAN.

- Security: AcmeCorp requires a contractor NDA for on-site personnel and an attendee list for badge pre-creation. Samantha, can your security team share the contractor access form?

I’ll book the test Zoom link and a 60-minute pre-call on Jun 11 to walk through the matrix.

Laura

All — thanks for the rapid responses. Quick summary & action items so nothing gets missed: 

Action items: 
- Miguel: bring transcode unit (if H.323 mixing is required), LTE aggregator for failover, two PoE+ switches, APC UPS. Confirm transit case dims by EOD Mon (assigned).
- Laura: finalize Jun 13 14:00–16:00 test window, send staging tokens to engineering leads, and confirm UPS battery expectations with building ops (assigned).
- Karthik: coordinate with networking to request VLAN + multicast for NDI and confirm QoS with building ISP (assigned).
- Samantha / AcmeCorp: send contractor NDA and loading dock access instructions; confirm parking pass pickup time (requested).

Plan: we’ll hold the two-hour test on Jun 13 14:00–16:00 PT. If we can’t secure Jun 12 for a full walk-through, we’ll do a remote pre-call on Jun 11 and proceed with the Jun 13 test.

Links & references: Drive folder with files & site photos: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAV-ops-lobby; Zoom test link: https://zoom.us/test/meet-12345; HubSpot deal: HUBSPOT-234567

Attachments to bring to the walk-through: codec_matrix_v1.xlsx; site_photos_5-28.zip; redwood-ops-lobby-floorplan.pdf

Thanks everyone — let’s confirm the transit case dims and NDA by Monday so the build team can pre-stage.
